name: L7-ascent
_notes: Two three-tile wall climbs. Floor at row 13; ledge 1 rises to row 10 at columns 10-30; ledge 2 rises to row 7 at columns 24-44, with the goal on it at column 40. A rise of three tiles is past the 2.37 a discrete full jump reaches, so neither ledge can be jumped onto: each one is a wall jump off its left face. The face is a dead end for a policy that just runs right, which is exactly why the move is discoverable - running into it and pressing jump is a wall jump. The reachability oracle refuses this level with wall jumps disabled, and only this one; measured first win: median 12.5 generations over 12 seeds at pop 200 (12 of 12 solved, 1-90). The slowest seed stalls for 89 generations at the first ledge before finding the climb.
